title: Question 18
passage:
Is it okay to leave the stroller here while I pay?
A. Could you move it right behind me? I need that doorway clear. B. Yes, I can take your fare as soon as you find your card. C. The front seats fold up when no one is using them.
passageZh:
我付車資時，可以把嬰兒推車先放這裡嗎？
A. 可以移到我正後方嗎？這個門口得保持暢通。 B. 可以，等你找到卡片，我就能收你的車資。 C. 前排座位沒人坐時可以折起來。
